_about: Print settings for the v6 parts, read by cad/slice.py. Values are OrcaSlicer's own keys and value formats (filament keys are lists). Layering: the system presets named here, then 'process'/'filament', then 'supports' (or enable_support 0), then the part's 'settings'. 'plates' are parts printed together, sliced into one project; one process slices a plate, so its parts share supports and settings, and the plate holds its own 'copies'. cad/slice.py writes 'orient', 'copies' and 'settings' back here when a project was saved from the GUI. Spec: cad/PRINT_LIST.md, Global print settings + Supports are the slicer's job.

feet.note: both feet on one plate, sole down

ankle_link.note: on its back (model +X up), the rear tine on the bed: the grip screws' teardrop roofs assume print-up = model +X (ankle_link.py). Supports under the web and the front tine

arm_fore_v6_L.note: on its back, web face down

arm_fore_v6_R.note: on its back, web face down

arm_upper_v6_L.note: on its back, web face down

arm_upper_v6_R.note: on its back, web face down

head_face.note: flat, outer (+X) face down, camera bosses up; the outer-face pocket is then a ~50 x 44 mm ceiling 1.8 mm up, so supports (PRINT_LIST says none: open question). head.py PRINT_ORIENT_FACE = eye(3) stands it on edge; the STL is in the assembly frame

hip_yoke_v6.note: on edge, model -Y on the bed; 5 mm outer brim

leg_link_v6.note: on its back, web face on the bed

yaw_bearing_housing.note: the face against the pelvis down

yaw_carrier_v6.note: horn-plate face down, bay walls rising
